label: Diagram 3.2
caption: Diagram 3.2 | Measurement of clear opening width and other features of external and internal doors Other communal doors
description: This is a plan view (Diagram 3.2) of a doorway set in a wall, shown with a door leaf and a curved arc indicating the door's swing. The wall is drawn as two horizontal lines with a gap in the middle; the left part has a stepped cut and the right part a solid block, with dashed lines across the opening. At the top left, label c marks the leading edge, and label d marks the following edge. A vertical line at the left of the opening is labelled a (inside face of door when open). The swing arc runs from the top down to a vertical line on the right of the opening, where a horizontal dimension e measures the nib to leading edge. At the bottom right, label b indicates the inside edge of door frame or stop, with horizontal dimension f below it for the nib to following edge, and a small vertical dimension g at the right of the opening (just above b) for reveal depth. A dimension line across the bottom reads "distance a-b = clear opening width". To the right, a Key lists items a to g and two Notes, and a footnote states all dimensions are minimum except where noted. A green banner at the foot titles the diagram "Measurement of clear opening width and other features of external and internal doors".
